newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin Central Q4 revenues set record.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin Central Q4 revenues set record.

text.p: Wisconsin Central Transportation Corp said Tuesday that its fourth quarter operating revenues reached a record $69.1 million, up four percent from $66.4 million a year ago.
Volume in the quarter increased 13 percent to a fourth quarter record of more than 117,000 revenue units, compared with a year ago, it added.

The largest volume increases in the quarter were sand, stone and minerals, as well as intermodal shipments. Volume increases were also recorded in wood pulp, lumber, wood fibers, metallic ore, clay products, coal and steel, the railroad reported.
Earlier, Wisconsin Central reported fourth quarter net earnings of $0.31 share, after a $0.03 a share debt prepayment charge, compared with $0.23 a year ago.

Fourth quarter 1996 results include equity in net income of affiliates of $10.2 million or $0.20 a share, an increase of $7.5 million from year ago. This includes a $2.3 million contribution from Trans Rail Holdings Ltd in New Zealand, down from $2.8 million a year ago. Earnings from English Welsh & Scottish Railway Holdings Ltd rose to $7.9 million from a year-ago loss of $75,000.
